description: Close a browser session and release its server-side resources (browser context, memory, and any open pages). Call this when you are done with a browser session to free resources and avoid hitting session limits. If the closed session is the currently active session, the internal session reference is cleared — subsequent tool calls will need a new navigate to create a fresh session.

session_id.description: Browser session ID to close. Must be an active session.

name: close_session
